subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair or adopt the open conflicting cross-repo Feishu candidate, or start a fresh same-repository fix for this reply @mention bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the same-repository PR is closed and the open exact candidate is cross-repo, conflicting, and previously associated with safety concerns around orphan placeholders and root routing.

options.title: Repair Or Replace Candidate
options.body: Use the open candidate as source context, but land a current-main fix with bot-specific mention evidence, routing tests, and Feishu proof.

options.title: Wait On Fork Author
options.body: Keep the issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address mention-gating, routing, and proof concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu Reply Work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu bug until channel ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Repair Or Replace Candidate
recommendation.body: Use the open candidate as source context, but land a current-main fix with bot-specific mention evidence, routing tests, and Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman merged several central Feishu mention, reply-target, and topic-session PRs and is the clearest routing owner for the repair/adopt/replace decision.
